hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Swedish dialects of the far north of Sweden, regardless of diachronic status, are counted as Swedish [swe] in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. However, some archaic varieties such as Överkalixmålet were not intelligible to standard Swedish (**hh:phon:Pihl:Overkalixmalet**:2) and thus at least one separate entry is warranted. See also: Swedish [swe].
